source_content.pdf_ref: Giải Thích Ngữ Pháp Tiếng Anh — Chương 9: Modal Verbs — can/could

starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: She ___ code in Python and JavaScript.
starter.explanation_long: Can = khả năng hiện tại. Could = khả năng quá khứ hoặc lịch sự.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Khả năng hiện tại → can code
starter.distractor_note: obvious: cans (không tồn tại), is can (sai)

starter.stem: When he was younger, he ___ fix any computer problem.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng trong quá khứ → could.
starter.explanation_long: 'When he was younger' = quá khứ → could fix.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Khả năng quá khứ → could fix

starter.stem: ___ I use the conference room for a meeting?
starter.explanation_short: Xin phép → Can I...? (informal) hoặc Could I...? (formal).
starter.explanation_long: Can I...? = xin phép informal. Could I...? = xin phép formal/lịch sự hơn.
starter.feedback_wrong: Can I = xin phép (informal). Could I = xin phép (formal).
starter.ielts_tip: Can I/Could I + V = xin phép.

starter.stem: Employees ___ access the system without a password.
starter.explanation_long: Phủ định: cannot (viết liền) hoặc can't. Không có 'cann't' hay 'don't can'.

starter.stem: ___ you please send me the project files?
starter.explanation_short: Yêu cầu lịch sự → Could you please...?
starter.explanation_long: Could you please = yêu cầu lịch sự. Can you = yêu cầu thông thường.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Yêu cầu lịch sự → Could you please...?
starter.ielts_tip: Could you please + V = lịch sự. Can you + V = thông thường.

starter.stem: This new software ___ process data 10 times faster than the old version.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng hiện tại của software → can.
starter.explanation_long: Mô tả khả năng hiện tại → can process.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Khả năng hiện tại → can process
starter.feedback_wrong: Khả năng hiện tại → can + V.
starter.ielts_tip: can = hiện tại. could = quá khứ/lịch sự/khả năng.

starter.stem: With better training, employees ___ improve their productivity significantly.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng lý thuyết (with better training) → could.
starter.explanation_long: 'With better training' = điều kiện giả định → could (khả năng nhưng chưa chắc chắn).
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Khả năng lý thuyết → could improve

starter.stem: The IT team ___ resolve the issue within an hour.
starter.explanation_short: Khả năng hiện tại cụ thể → can resolve.
starter.explanation_long: Mô tả khả năng giải quyết hiện tại → can.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Khả năng hiện tại → can resolve
starter.feedback_wrong: can + V = khả năng hiện tại.
starter.ielts_tip: can + V bare. Không cần 'is able to' khi dùng can.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'She can to speak three programming languages.'
options: Sai: can to speak → can speak (bỏ to)
starter.correct_answer: Sai: can to speak → can speak (bỏ to)
starter.explanation_short: can + V bare infinitive (không to): can speak.
starter.explanation_long: Modal verb + V bare infinitive. Không dùng 'can to speak'.
starter.feedback_wrong: can + V bare. Không bao giờ 'can to V'.
starter.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Không dùng to sau modal.

starter.stem: We ___ try a different approach to solve this technical problem.
starter.explanation_long: Could + V = suggestion (nhẹ nhàng, lịch sự).
starter.ielts_tip: could = suggestion. can = ability. must = obligation.

build_up.stem: Before the update, users ___ only upload 5MB files, but now they ___ upload up to 100MB.
build_up.explanation_short: Quá khứ → could. Hiện tại → can.
build_up.explanation_long: Before = quá khứ → could upload. Now = hiện tại → can upload.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Quá khứ: could. Hiện tại: can.
build_up.ielts_tip: Past ability → could. Present ability → can.

build_up.stem: In a formal business email, which is MOST appropriate?
options: Can you send me the report?
Could you kindly send me the report?
You can send me the report.
build_up.correct_answer: Could you kindly send me the report?
build_up.explanation_long: Business email formal: 'Could you kindly' = lịch sự nhất.
build_up.feedback_wrong: Could you kindly = formal polite request.
build_up.ielts_tip: Business email: Could you kindly/please + V = professional.

build_up.stem: Thanks to cloud computing, employees ___ access work files from anywhere.
build_up.explanation_short: Khả năng hiện tại nhờ công nghệ → can.
build_up.explanation_long: Thanks to + công nghệ hiện tại → can access (khả năng hiện tại).
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Khả năng hiện tại → can access

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'The new AI system can to analyze thousands of data points per second.'
options: Sai: can to analyze → can analyze
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: can to analyze → can analyze
build_up.explanation_short: can + V bare: can analyze (không can to analyze).
build_up.explanation_long: Modal + V bare infinitive. 'Can to analyze' = sai.
build_up.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Lỗi phổ biến ở band 5.0.

build_up.stem: With the right investment, Vietnam ___ become a leading tech hub in Southeast Asia.
build_up.explanation_short: Khả năng tương lai có điều kiện → could.
build_up.explanation_long: 'With the right investment' = điều kiện → could become (khả năng nhưng chưa chắc).
build_up.distractor_note: plausible: can (khả năng chung), must (quá mạnh)

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'Workers don't can use personal devices for company work.'
build_up.explanation_short: Phủ định modal: can't/cannot, KHÔNG dùng don't + modal.
build_up.explanation_long: Modal verb không dùng 'don't': don't can = sai. Đúng: can't / cannot.
build_up.feedback_wrong: Phủ định modal: can't. Không dùng don't can.
build_up.ielts_tip: Modal phủ định: can't, couldn't, won't. Không dùng don't/doesn't.

build_up.stem: If the server were upgraded, we ___ handle twice as many users.
build_up.explanation_long: Conditional Type 2: If + V2 (were), could + V. Khả năng giả định.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + were/V2, could + V = Conditional Type 2.

build_up.stem: After six months of training, she was ___ build complex web applications.
build_up.explanation_short: was + able to + V = khả năng cụ thể trong quá khứ.
build_up.explanation_long: was/were able to = managed to (khả năng đạt được trong quá khứ). Can không dùng sau was.
build_up.ielts_tip: was able to = managed to (specific past ability).

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'When she was a student, she can program in five languages.'
build_up.explanation_short: 'When she was a student' = quá khứ → could, không phải can.
build_up.explanation_long: Quá khứ (was a student) → could program.
build_up.feedback_wrong: was a student = quá khứ → could.

build_up.stem: Modern smartphones ___ perform tasks that desktop computers ___ only do a decade ago.
build_up.explanation_short: Hiện tại (smartphones) → can. Quá khứ (a decade ago) → could.
build_up.explanation_long: Modern = hiện tại → can. A decade ago = quá khứ → could.
build_up.feedback_correct: ⚡ Hiện tại: can. Quá khứ: could.
build_up.ielts_tip: can = present ability. could = past ability.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Artificial intelligence can to process vast amounts of data, which can helps businesses make better decisions.'
challenge.explanation_short: can + V bare: can process (không can to process).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'can to process' → 'can process'. Lớp 2: 'can helps' cũng sai → 'can help'. Cả A và C sai, A sai trước.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C (can helps) cũng sai — bẫy kép

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho business email:
options: Can you review the proposal by Friday?
Could you possibly review the proposal by Friday?
You can review the proposal by Friday.
challenge.correct_answer: Could you possibly review the proposal by Friday?
challenge.explanation_short: Business email lịch sự → Could you possibly...?
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Could you possibly' = formal + polite. Lớp 2: 'Can you' = informal. Lớp 3: 'You can' = giving permission, not request.
challenge.ielts_tip: Business email: Could you possibly/kindly + V.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đúng nhưng informal

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Employees doesn't can access confidential files without proper authorization from management.'
challenge.explanation_short: don't/doesn't + can = sai. Đúng: can't/cannot access.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'doesn't can' → 'cannot/can't' (modal không dùng do/does). Lớp 2: 'Employees doesn't' cũng sai số (employees = plural → don't).
challenge.feedback_wrong: Modal phủ định: can't. Không dùng don't/doesn't.
challenge.ielts_tip: Modal + not = cannot. Không dùng do/does + modal.

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT cho IELTS Speaking Part 3:
options: Technology can solves many problems in education.
Technology could solve many problems in education
Technology can to solve many problems in education.
Technology could solves many problems in education.
challenge.correct_answer: Technology could solve many problems in education, if properly implemented.
challenge.explanation_short: Điều kiện (if properly implemented) → could solve.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'could solve' = conditional possibility. Lớp 2: 'can solves' sai (can + V bare). Lớp 3: 'can to solve' sai. Lớp 4: 'could solves' sai.
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: could + V = cautious opinion.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (can solves) và D (could solves) đều sai -s

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'Ten years ago, most people ___ [A] only access the internet at home, but now they ___ [B] use it anywhere.'
challenge.explanation_short: Ten years ago (past) → could. Now (present) → can.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Ten years ago' = quá khứ → could access. Lớp 2: 'now' = hiện tại → can use.
challenge.feedback_wrong: Ten years ago → could. Now → can.
challenge.ielts_tip: Past ability → could. Present ability → can.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A đảo ngược thì

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'The old system can only handle 100 users simultaneously, but the new one could support 10,000.'
options: The old system can only handle
but the new one could support
challenge.correct_answer: but the new one could support
challenge.explanation_short: New system = hiện tại → CAN support, không phải could.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'the new one could' → 'the new one can' (hệ thống mới = hiện tại → can). Lớp 2: 'The old system can' cũng cần xem lại — nếu old system đã thay thế → could. Nhưng option C sai rõ nhất.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 New system = hiện tại → can support!
challenge.feedback_wrong: New = hiện tại → can. Old (nếu đã thay) → could.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (old system + can) có thể sai nếu đã thay thế

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Education can helps people find better jobs and improve their lives.
Education can help people find better jobs and could improve their overall quality of life.
Education could to help people find better jobs.
Education can help people find better jobs and improve their overall quality of life.
challenge.correct_answer: Education can help people find better jobs and improve their overall quality of life.
challenge.explanation_short: can help + (can) improve = parallel structure chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'can help... and improve' = parallel (can áp dụng cho cả hai V). Lớp 2: Option B trộn can/could — không nhất quán. Lớp 3: 'can helps' sai, 'could to help' sai.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 can help and improve = parallel chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: can + V1 and V2 = parallel structure.
challenge.ielts_tip: can + V and V = parallel. Không trộn can/could.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B (can + could) không nhất quán

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If the company invested more in R&D, they can develop groundbreaking products that could change the industry.'
options: If the company invested more in R&D
challenge.explanation_short: If + V2 (invested) → could develop, không phải can.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: Conditional Type 2: If + V2 (invested) → could + V (develop). 'Can' = sai trong Conditional Type 2. Lớp 2: 'could change' = đúng.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🔥 If + V2 → could, không phải can!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Conditional Type 2: If + V2, could + V.
challenge.ielts_tip: If + V2, could + V. Không dùng can.

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Bạn nghĩ công nghệ có thể giải quyết ô nhiễm không?' — Chọn câu trả lời CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Technology can definitely solving pollution problems.
I believe technology could play a significant role in reducing pollution.
Technology could to solve pollution if we try harder.
I think technology can to help with pollution.
challenge.correct_answer: I believe technology could play a significant role in reducing pollution.
challenge.explanation_short: I believe + could = cautious opinion chuẩn Speaking.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'could play' = cautious opinion (phù hợp Speaking Part 3). Lớp 2: 'can solving' sai (can + V bare). Lớp 3: 'could to solve' sai. Lớp 4: 'can to help' sai.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 I believe + could + V = chuẩn Speaking Part 3!
challenge.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: I believe/think + could + V.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: các option khác đều sai ngữ pháp modal

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'Technology [A] can to improve healthcare access, but governments [B] doesn't can ignore the digital divide that [C] could prevents rural communities from benefiting.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] can to → can. [B] doesn't can → cannot. [C] could prevents → could prevent.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'can to improve' → 'can improve' (modal + V bare). Lớp 2: [B] 'doesn't can' → 'cannot' (modal không dùng do/does). Lớp 3: [C] 'could prevents' → 'could prevent' (modal + V bare, no -s).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] can improve | [B] cannot | [C] could prevent!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] can + V (no to). [B] cannot (no doesn't). [C] could + V (no -s).
challenge.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Modal phủ định: can't/cannot.

items.stem: When he was younger, he ___ fix any computer problem.

items.ielts_tip: Could you please + V = lịch sự. Can you + V = thông thường.

items.stem: The IT team ___ resolve the issue within an hour.
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 Khả năng hiện tại → can resolve
items.feedback_wrong: can + V = khả năng hiện tại.
items.explanation_short: Khả năng hiện tại cụ thể → can resolve.
items.ielts_tip: can + V bare. Không cần 'is able to' khi dùng can.

items.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'She can to speak three programming languages.'
options: Sai: can to speak → can speak (bỏ to)
items.correct_answer: Sai: can to speak → can speak (bỏ to)
items.feedback_wrong: can + V bare. Không bao giờ 'can to V'.
items.explanation_short: can + V bare infinitive (không to): can speak.
items.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Không dùng to sau modal.

items.stem: We ___ try a different approach to solve this technical problem.
items.explanation_short: Gợi ý → could try.
items.ielts_tip: could = suggestion. can = ability. must = obligation.

items.correct_answer: but the new one could support
items.feedback_correct: 🔥 New system = hiện tại → can support!
items.feedback_wrong: New = hiện tại → can. Old (nếu đã thay) → could.

items.stem: Chọn câu body Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Education can helps people find better jobs and improve their lives.
Education can help people find better jobs and could improve their overall quality of life.
Education could to help people find better jobs.
Education can help people find better jobs and improve their overall quality of life.
items.correct_answer: Education can help people find better jobs and improve their overall quality of life.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 can help and improve = parallel chuẩn!
items.feedback_wrong: can + V1 and V2 = parallel structure.
items.explanation_short: can help + (can) improve = parallel structure chuẩn.
items.ielts_tip: can + V and V = parallel. Không trộn can/could.

Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?

items.explanation_short: If + V2 (invested) → could develop, không phải can.
items.ielts_tip: If + V2, could + V. Không dùng can.

items.stem: Speaking Part 3: 'Bạn nghĩ công nghệ có thể giải quyết ô nhiễm không?' — Chọn câu trả lời CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Technology can definitely solving pollution problems.
I believe technology could play a significant role in reducing pollution.
Technology could to solve pollution if we try harder.
I think technology can to help with pollution.
items.correct_answer: I believe technology could play a significant role in reducing pollution.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 I believe + could + V = chuẩn Speaking Part 3!
items.explanation_short: I believe + could = cautious opinion chuẩn Speaking.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 3: I believe/think + could + V.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'Technology [A] can to improve healthcare access, but governments [B] doesn't can ignore the digital divide that [C] could prevents rural communities from benefiting.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] can improve | [B] cannot | [C] could prevent!
items.feedback_wrong: [A] can + V (no to). [B] cannot (no doesn't). [C] could + V (no -s).
items.explanation_short: [A] can to → can. [B] doesn't can → cannot. [C] could prevents → could prevent.
items.ielts_tip: Modal + V bare. Modal phủ định: can't/cannot.
